model.name: normal RAPM
model.season_scoring_environment: remove each season's mean points per possession before fitting player effects

peak_eligibility.rule: offensive and defensive possession counts must each be at least 1000 in every constituent season

tie_break: larger minimum offensive or defensive possession count
caveats: The possession archive is stale after 2024.
The model has no box-score prior and does not estimate uncertainty.
Peak selection creates winner's-curse bias and is descriptive.
